info.name: SPARK-340 Admin Platform Policies & Integrations (UAT)
info.description: UAT for SPARK-340 / SPARK-370. Use the local stack, real Admin/Owner/Driver tokens, a published site policy, a driver-owned vehicle and a bookable slot. Use an isolated zero-deposit booking fixture or settle its sandbox order. Folder 04 derives the booking ID from the admission receipt for the reviewed terms. An explicit skip means no proof for that case. Store only sanitized evidence.
